title: Qualify real manager timers and interrupted-wake recovery
description: Manager check-in timers and stale-work review exist in source, but no host timer has been installed. Prepare separate owner-reviewed install/run/remove rehearsal; prove direct-report inspection, approval waits, budget guards, durable dispatch and unknown-launch recovery with actual providers. Do not enable host scheduling from task creation.
acceptanceCriteria: Approved bounded dispatch produces durable receipts and respects direct-report boundaries
Interrupted unknown launches never duplicate or assume terminated providers
Scheduler removal is verified and no timer remains after the rehearsal
